user_saw: Installing an external plugin in an experimental Bun AOT build could fail because Bun refused to register a resolver that matched the executable’s compiled entry point.
summary: The fix excludes the exact Bun.main path from the captured-source resolver’s filter while preserving matches for similarly prefixed external paths.
reasoning: The September plugin reload change registered `builder.onResolve` with `filter: /.*/` and relied on the callback to redirect only files owned by a plugin. I checked that the filter was already present when #172384 added `--compile-aot`, bringing the resolver into a compiled executable where Bun rejects a matching entry-point filter before calling the callback. The fix PR’s compiled fixture reproduced that registration failure.
